limitations: Linux Chromium CPU results do not establish iPhone memory capacity or speed.
Offline test covers warm in-memory inference, not a cold offline application launch.
Structured parsing is interpretation only; every operation needs separate verified manual evidence.

interruptionReason: Concurrent browser inference exceeded shared executor memory; Linux cgroup OOM killed renderer processes. This is not a valid isolated single-model benchmark and not evidence about iPhone capacity.
